Number formatting in PHW style

Source: R/labels.R
phw_number.Rd

Thousands separated with commas and a fixed number of decimals.

Usage

phw_number(accuracy = 1, ...)

phw_percent(accuracy = 0.1, ...)

Arguments

accuracy

Rounding, as in scales::label_number().

...

Passed to scales::label_number() or scales::label_percent().

Value

A labelling function.

Examples

phw_number()(c(1234.5, 98765))
#> [1] "1,234"  "98,765"
phw_percent()(0.432)
#> [1] "43.2%"
